title: The Legacy, washed
logline: The Legacy in Gully's lot with a hose on it, washed for the first time the page has seen, the faded green two shades in one panel where the grime was. Gully's son, eleven, with the hose. Twelve years.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon in a gravel lot with a boy of eleven hosing it, the paint two shades where the grime is washed off, a bucket, sun.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon in a gravel lot being hosed by a boy of eleven with the paint showing two shades where grime is washed off, a bucket beside him, sun, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
